question_or_proposition: For Outfall 001 Flow, do the discharge-limitation entries ('Report MGD' in the lbs/day columns and '***' in the mg/l columns) together with the monitoring frequency '2/Week (*1)' and footnote *1 ('When discharging') establish that (i) no enforceable numeric effluent limit applies to Flow for compliance comparison, and (ii) flow monitoring and reporting obligations apply only during periods when Outfall 001 is discharging?
required_context: Section heading: FINAL Effluent Limits – Outfall 001 – Intermittent Flow
Footnote *2: Estimate flow measurements and accuracy provisions
source_locator: Page: 3, Section: part_i, DISCHARGE LIMITATIONS table (Flow)
notes: The nominated Flow row pairs report-only limit notation with a discharge-conditioned monitoring footnote on an intermittent outfall; resolving its scope affects whether numeric limit comparisons apply (Purpose A), when monitoring was required (Purpose B), and how to classify missing flow evidence during non-discharge periods (Purpose C).
